goal: Implement isolated SMART outbound Kafka ingestion on `aws.mulesoft.onemac.events` using a dedicated Lambda and dedicated LATEST event source mapping, plus `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED` validation, transformation, hidden ID reservation, and non-mutating collision logging for OY2-40481 and OY2-41233.

tasks.title: TDD envelope validation and dispatch
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` using base64 Kafka records from `mocks/helpers/kafka.utils.ts`, without adding SMART cases to CDC sink tests.
Tests successful base64 decoding when the Kafka key equals `payload.id`.
Tests that malformed key/value encoding, invalid JSON, and key/id mismatch are logged and skipped without rejecting the batch.
Tests every required field: `spaWaiverId`, `id`, `correlationId`, `origin`, `authority`, `status`, `createdAt`, `createdByUserId`, `createdByName`, and `createdByEmail`.
Tests exact `origin: "SMART"`; alternate casing and `source` in place of `origin` fail validation.
Tests extra properties are accepted and remain available after parsing.
Tests `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED` dispatch and unknown or absent `operationType` validation-log-skip behavior without throwing.
Tests one invalid record does not prevent another valid batch record from being processed.
Tests the SMART code path does not invoke CDC, changelog, or email processors.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` is red only because the production implementation is absent.

tasks.title: Implement SMART envelope dispatcher
acceptance_criteria: Adds `lib/lambda/sinkSmart.ts` and validation/dispatch helpers under `lib/lambda/smart/`.
Decodes Kafka keys and values from base64 before validating or parsing them.
Requires the locked envelope fields, exact `origin: "SMART"`, and key equal to `payload.id`, while permitting extra properties.
Handles malformed records independently by logging and skipping them rather than poisoning the batch.
Dispatches only `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED`; all other operation types are validated, logged, and skipped without throwing.
Imports and invokes none of `processEmails`, `sinkChangelog`, `sinkMainProcessors`, or `insertOneMacRecordsFromKafkaIntoMako`.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.

tasks.title: TDD manual-record transformation
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts` with the documented `AL-26-0817-0001` payload.
Tests `id`, exact `origin: "SMART"`, `authority`, and `deleted: false`.
Tests the working U1 default `SEATOOL_STATUS.SUBMITTED` and verifies through the real `isActiveMainNonDraftPackage` helper that the reservation blocks reuse.
Tests state derives from the normalized ID using the existing `id.slice(0, 2)` and uppercase pattern, producing `AL` rather than `Alabama`.
Tests `createdAt` maps to the main-index ISO timestamp fields identified in the spec and leaves `proposedDate` unset.
Tests `createdByName` maps to `submitterName` and `createdByEmail` maps to `submitterEmail`.
Tests `spaWaiverId`, `correlationId`, `operationType`, `creationContext`, and `createdByUserId` are retained.
Tests the transform is pure and performs no OpenSearch or CloudWatch operation.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts` is red only because the transform is absent.

tasks.title: Implement manual-record transformation
acceptance_criteria: Adds a pure transform in `lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.ts` using only mappings supported by the spec evidence.
Sets `seatoolStatus` to `SEATOOL_STATUS.SUBMITTED` as the working default and includes an inline U1 comment stating that product confirmation is still required.
Derives `state` with the existing uppercase ID-prefix pattern and includes an inline U8 comment stating that the mapping remains a proposal.
Does not invent a renamed field for the incoming full state name while U8 remains unresolved.
Retains the required identifiers and documented event metadata needed by later SMART handlers.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.

tasks.title: TDD reservation and collision handling
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts` with mocked OpenSearch and CloudWatch Logs clients.
Tests that a missing main-index `_id` causes exactly one reservation write keyed by the event ID and no collision-log write.
Tests that any existing main-index document with the same ID, regardless of origin, causes zero OpenSearch mutations.
Tests collision handling calls `CreateLogStream` before `PutLogEvents` and tolerates `ResourceAlreadyExistsException`.
Tests the collision event contains `id`, `spaWaiverId`, `correlationId`, `operationType`, existing origin, and incoming payload context.
Tests log group and stream names come from environment configuration using the U3 proposed defaults.
Tests CloudWatch logging failures are reported but do not reject the Kafka batch.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts` is red only because the writer and logger are absent.

tasks.title: Implement reservation collision writer
acceptance_criteria: Adds an exists/get-by-ID reservation writer under `lib/lambda/smart/` targeting the main index.
On a miss, writes the transformed reservation with `_id` equal to `id`; on a hit, performs no update, bulk upsert, or overwrite.
Adds `@aws-sdk/client-cloudwatch-logs` to `lib/lambda/package.json` and implements `CreateLogStream` followed by `PutLogEvents`.
Treats `ResourceAlreadyExistsException` as successful stream initialization.
Reads collision group and stream names from environment variables with U3-proposal defaults and an inline unresolved-U3 comment.
Connects `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED` dispatch to the transform and reservation writer.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts`, `./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts`, and `./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` exit 0.
`bun run lint` and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.

tasks.title: Verify ID blocking and list hiding
acceptance_criteria: Adds regression coverage to the existing `itemExists`, `checkIdentifierUsage`, and search test suites using a transformed SMART reservation fixture.
Tests `itemExists` treats the SMART reservation as active and blocks reuse because its `seatoolStatus` is non-draft.
Tests `checkIdentifierUsage` blocks the same non-deleted SMART ID.
Tests the existing `origin.keyword` allowlist excludes SMART from package-list search results without adding a hide flag.
Makes no production changes to `itemExists.ts`, `checkIdentifierUsage.ts`, or `search.ts`; a failure is reported as a U1/default defect.
All three focused regression suites exit 0.

tasks.title: TDD SMART package-detail hiding
acceptance_criteria: Adds cases to `lib/lambda/item.test.ts` showing SMART reservation details are not returned to at least one state-user role and one CMS/admin role.
Adds a control proving an otherwise equivalent `OneMAC` document remains visible.
Expressly marks this behavior as the U2 planner recommendation rather than a confirmed product decision.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/item.test.ts` is red only for the new SMART cases.

tasks.title: Implement SMART package-detail hiding
acceptance_criteria: Updates `lib/lambda/item.ts` so `origin === "SMART"` reservations return the existing not-found/denied response instead of package details.
Leaves non-SMART detail behavior unchanged.
Includes an inline U2 comment stating that the exclusion is a planner recommendation awaiting product confirmation.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/item.test.ts`, `./run test --run lib/lambda/search.test.ts`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.

tasks.title: TDD dedicated SMART infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/stacks/data.smart-events.test.ts` using `Template.fromStack` and the repository's configured stage fixtures.
Uses `describe.each` or an equivalent loop covering every configured environment that consumes the CDC topic, including every non-production environment.
Tests creation/consumption of the correctly namespaced `aws.mulesoft.onemac.events` topic wherever CDC is consumed.
Tests a dedicated SMART Lambda and standalone event source mapping with `StartingPosition: LATEST` and a SMART-only consumer group.
Tests SMART is absent from CDC, changelog, email, and reindex `createTriggers` mappings.
Tests a dedicated collision log group and least-privilege `logs:CreateLogStream` and `logs:PutLogEvents` permissions.
Tests the Lambda receives collision group/stream environment variables and receives no SES permission.
`./run test --run lib/stacks/data.smart-events.test.ts` is red only for absent SMART infrastructure.

tasks.title: Implement dedicated SMART infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: Exports `sinkSmart` from `lib/lambda/index.ts` and creates its dedicated Lambda in `lib/stacks/data.ts`.
Adds the namespaced SMART topic alongside CDC topic creation and development cleanup wherever those mechanisms apply.
Adds an email-style standalone `CfnEventSourceMapping` with `LATEST`, isolated from reindex `createTriggers`, CDC, changelog, and email mappings.
Uses a distinct consumer group ID and documents inline that an offset reset requires recreating the mapping with a new group ID.
Creates the proposed U3 collision log group, passes group/stream names to the Lambda, and grants scoped CloudWatch Logs permissions.
Grants the SMART Lambda required OpenSearch access and no SES permissions.
Makes no behavioral change to `lib/stacks/email.ts`, CDC processors, or existing CDC/changelog mappings.
`./run test --run lib/stacks/data.smart-events.test.ts`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.

tasks.title: Register operations and verify slice
acceptance_criteria: Registers the new Lambda in `.github/skills/splunk/references/source-mapping.md` using the existing table format.
Adds a concise repo-local runbook note explaining that normal deployment starts at LATEST and offset reset requires recreating the mapping with a new consumer group ID.
The runbook limits `TRIM_HORIZON` or `AT_TIMESTAMP` to deliberate replay and states that reusing a consumer group resumes committed offsets.
The runbook identifies U1, U2, U3, U8, and U11 as unresolved assumptions requiring confirmation before production rollout.
Focused SMART Lambda, ID-blocking, search/detail, and stack tests all exit 0.
`bun run lint` and `bun run test-tsc` exit 0.
No secrets, credentials, or account IDs are added.

routing.reason: PlanPacket risk=high (OpenSearch write + CloudWatch Logs SDK). Roster frontier slug unavailable; using latest available Claude thinking.
CDK test authoring; parallel after T6.
PlanPacket risk=high (Kafka ESM, IAM, topic create). Roster frontier slug unavailable; using latest available Claude thinking.
Exports, Splunk map, runbook. Standard implementer is enough.

assumptions: U1 UNRESOLVED: use `SEATOOL_STATUS.SUBMITTED` as the working implementation default because it is non-draft and maps to CMS `Submitted - Intake Needed`; retain an inline U1 comment and confirm before deployment.
U2 UNRESOLVED: hiding SMART reservations from `lib/lambda/item.ts` detail responses is a planner recommendation. Existing list hiding in `lib/lambda/search.ts` is already confirmed.
U3 UNRESOLVED: use environment-driven defaults `/aws/mako/${stage}/smart-onemac-collisions` and `msp-manual-record-created`; retention and final operational names remain unconfirmed.

U8 UNRESOLVED: derive the indexed two-letter state from the uppercased package ID with the existing `id.slice(0, 2)` pattern; do not invent a renamed field for the full SMART state while this remains open.

U11 UNRESOLVED: use an email-style standalone `CfnEventSourceMapping` at LATEST and exclude SMART from reindex `createTriggers`; this is the preferred implementation, not a confirmed product decision.
Unknown operation types are validated, logged, and skipped. They are not persisted outside Kafka in this slice.
`createdAt` supplies the documented ISO timestamp fields and `proposedDate` remains unset.
`spaWaiverId` is retained pending OY2-39746 and may be renamed by that later schema work.
The accepted exists-then-write reservation flow has a race window; atomic `op_type=create` hardening is deferred.
A verifier running `./run install` may dirty `bun.lockb`; unrelated lockfile churn must not be staged.
The pre-push hook runs ESLint and detect-secrets.
out_of_scope: Handlers for `MSP_ADMINISTRATIVE_FIELD_UPDATED`, `MSP_STATUS_UPDATED`, `MSP_SPLIT_SPA_CREATED`, `MSP_RAI_WITHDRAWAL_TOGGLED`, `MSP_ASSIGNMENT_UPDATED`, or any other operation type.
Changes to SMART or MuleSoft producers.
Routing SMART events through CDC, changelog, migration, or email processors.
Showing SMART reservations as submissions in package lists or detail workflows.
Mutating or merging fields into an existing document when a collision occurs.
Persisting unknown operation types to another index or dead-letter store.
Deploying infrastructure, resetting real Kafka offsets, committing, pushing, or opening a pull request.
